decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical FCB structure and related masks.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The prior FCBIO comparison covered 1224 bytes with only three marked DosDseg address bytes differing (review 067).
The prior FCBIO2 comparison covered 778 bytes with five differing bytes in marked function address fields (review 068).
limitations: The comparisons support fields used by the selected modules, but do not establish all FCB variants or original historical source identity. Final addresses and complete kernel equality remain unverified.
